notes.title: Digimon Story Time Stranger is coming soon!
notes.content:
[h2]Explore the deep bond between [b]humans [/b]and [b]Digimon[/b]![/h2]

[h3][b]Digimon Story Time Stranger [/b]is an RPG with monster-taming elements that explores the deep bond between humans and Digimon in an epic story that unravels the mystery of the world’s collapse.[/h3]

[h3][b][i]Discover the trailer now[/i][/b] 🔽[/h3]

[previewyoutube=anPV_mRq8Lc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Embark on a mission where chance encounters with unique characters will shape your journey across time and parallel worlds. 
Collect, raise and customize a diverse array of Digimon to tackle challenges in your own way.[/h3]

[h3][b]Learn more :[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1984270/Digimon_Story_Time_Stranger/

notes.title: (Re)discover DIGIMON WORLD: NEXT ORDER
notes.content:
[h3]Return to the Digital World to raise powerful Digimon, uncover the secrets of Machinedramon, and build a Digi-metropolis on Floatia![/h3]

[previewyoutube=wBZ1AOEqqDQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]In addition to the game, players will receive for free the "Bonus Item Set". 

This set will include a Parameter Boost Set and two Special Cores to digivolve into Omegamon and Imperialdramon PM.[/h3]
